annotations.title: Close a vote (hosts and organizers only)

description: Closes a vote and, unless announce is false, sends one notice with the winning option, all tied options on a tie. quiet true sends it with no lock-screen alert. Hosts and organizers only.

announce.description: Default true: one notice with the winner. False closes without one.

confirm.description: Absent previews the winner; true closes the vote.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

quiet.description: True: the notice carries no lock-screen alert.

requestId.description: Optional caller id; one id closes once.

voteId.description: The vote; the latest when absent.

name: event_vote_close
title: Close a vote (hosts and organizers only)
